jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. The Role We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally. This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams. What You’ll Do Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations. Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities. Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach. Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs. Conduct talent mappin

jobs.title: Senior HR Officer
jobs.description: Krijg jij energie van internationale HR-vraagstukken, het uitzoeken van complexe regelgeving en het slimmer inrichten van processen? Wil jij niet alleen uitvoeren, maar ook meedenken, adviseren en verbeteren? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou! Bij Zwart zorgen we ervoor dat de wereld blijft draaien, ook als de stroom uitvalt. Met onze innovatieve noodstroom- en energieoplossingen dragen we bij aan de bedrijfszekerheid van onder andere datacenters, ziekenhuizen en industriële bedrijven in binnen- en buitenland. Zwart is een groeiende organisatie met een internationaal karakter. Dat brengt interessante HR-vraagstukken met zich mee op het gebied van internationale mobiliteit, wet- en regelgeving en klantvereisten. Als Senior HR Officer ben jij binnen HR onder andere het aanspreekpunt op het gebied van internationale mobiliteit en compliance. Je zorgt ervoor dat internationale collega's goed voorbereid bij Zwart kunnen starten en dat onze medewerkers over de juiste documentatie beschikken om in binnen- en buitenland aan het werk te gaan. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en denkt vooruit. Daarbij krijg je volop ruimte om internationale HR-processen verder op te zetten, te verbeteren en te professionaliseren. Waar ga jij je onder andere mee bezighouden? Je bent een toegankelijk en servicegericht aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en leidinggevenden bij dagelijkse HR-vragen en HR-processen. Je ondersteunt HR Business Partners bij operationele en administratieve HR-vraagstukken en draagt bij aan een soepele uitvoering van HR-beleid en medewerkerstrajecten. Je bent samen met HR Administratie verantwoordelijk voor een correcte uitvoering van HR-processen, zoals in-, door- en uitstroom, personeelsmutaties en dossierbeheer. Je coördineert de HR-processen rondom internationale medewerkers en adviseert en ondersteunt bij visa, werk- en verblijfsvergunningen, kennismigrantenprocedures en overige registraties. jobs.description: Why roadsurfer? CAMPER BUDGET: You get an annual camper budget to experience the #happyroadsurfing lifestyle for yourself. DISCOUNTS : Use our Coverflex and Family & Friends Discounts. The role - your passion You are the sparring partner for leaders and the contact person for employees in our HQ departments – across the full lifecycle, from hiring to exit. You empower our managers to own their hiring: you set up lean processes, sharpen their interview skills and step in where it matters, from needs clarification to offers. You enable, coach and challenge our leaders to grow into strong role models for their teams – and guide them through difficult situations such as performance plans and exits. You drive our AI-first way of working in HR: you use AI tools and automations every day, spot new use cases and build them into our processes. What you need to surf the wave with us 4+ years in HR with experience in both recruiting and People/HR Business Partnering , across the full employee lifecycle. Confidence coaching leaders and handling complex cases, ideally in multi-country settings. Knowledge of labour law in different countries is a plus. You already use AI tools actively in your HR work and enjoy finding new ways to automate and simplify. You thrive in a fast-changing company, get up to speed quickly and guide leaders and teams through change. A structured way of working, empathy and a proactive, team-oriented mindset. Business fluent English, german is a plus. Your Salary We ❤️ transparency. The salary range for this position is between 50.000 EUR and 65.000 EUR gross per year. jobs.title: Senior Project & Process Manager – HR Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. This is a senior role for someone who takes on our tougher operational problems and drives them forward together with the teams involved. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top. At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale. Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together. This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model). jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Science - EMEA
jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Science & Research Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own the hiring of the researchers and scientists who push our frontier models forward. You will partner closely with our Science leadership and research leads to find, engage, and secure exceptional talent: research scientists and research engineers. You will also hire for Mistral Discovery, our initiative pushing AI development in real-world industries, bringing scientific talent to the problems where AI can have the greatest practical impact. This is one of the most competitive talent markets in the world. You will be competing with the best-funded labs and big tech for a small pool of people, many of whom are not looking for a job. As an early member of the team, you will shape how we recruit scientists at Mistral and build the foundations to scale it. What You Will Do Source and engage world-class researchers through direct outreach, academic networks, publications, open-source contributions, and the international conference circuit (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). Build a deep understanding of our research areas and the wider AI research landscape, so you can hold credible conversations with scientists about their work and our research direction. jobs.description: Bufab Flos is op zoek naar een enthousiaste en leergierige HR-stagiair(e) die ons team komt versterken. Tijdens je stage krijg je de mogelijkheid om praktijkervaring op te doen binnen diverse HR-werkzaamheden, jezelf te ontwikkelen én actief mee te draaien binnen de organisatie. Wie zijn wij? Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Wij zijn specialist in het leveren van bevestigingsmaterialen, technische componenten en logistieke diensten. Dat doen we niet zomaar: wij denken actief mee met onze klanten en adviseren bij technische vraagstukken. Of het nu gaat om A‑merk bevestigingsmaterialen, staal, RVS, gestandaardiseerde onderdelen, assemblages of maatwerk volgens klantspecificatie — wij regelen het volledig. Van sourcing en inkoop tot kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag en levering. In alles wat we doen staat één doel centraal: onze klanten maximaal ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en logistiek. Ons uitgangspunt is daarbij helder: afspraak is afspraak. Met 140 betrokken collega’s vormen we een divers en internationaal team. Bufab Flos maakt onderdeel uit van het Zweedse Bufab, maar is tegelijkertijd een toegankelijke organisatie waar samenwerken centraal staat. Onze medewerkers maken het verschil – en HR speelt hierin een belangrijke rol. Om onze HR-afdeling te versterken én jou de kans te geven om ervaring op te doen, bieden wij een leerzame en veelzijdige meewerkstage op HBO/Bachelor-niveau aan. Wat ga je doen? Als HR-stagiair(e) draai je volledig mee binnen het HR-team en krijg een brede kijk op het HR-vak. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: 🔍 Ondersteunen bij werving- en selectie 🚀 Ondersteunen bij onboarding en offboarding 🗂️ Up-to-date houden van onze HR-systemen 🤝 Ondersteuning bij verzuimbegeleiding 💡 Meewerken aan HR-projecten zoals

jobs.title: HR Recruitment Specialist
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1 Psikologi / Manajemen Sumber Daya Manusia. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun di bidang Recruitment/HR. Terbiasa menjalankan proses end-to-end recruitment, mulai dari sourcing, screening CV, psikotes, interview, hingga penilaian kandidat. Mampu melakukan sourcing dan publikasi lowongan melalui berbagai platform recruitment dan media sosial. Memahami Manpower Planning (MPP) dan kebutuhan manpower perusahaan. Memiliki pengalaman dalam pelaksanaan psikotes, baik sebagai tester maupun dalam administrasi proses tes, menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu melakukan interview dan memiliki kemampuan analisa serta penilaian kandidat. Komunikatif, teliti, proaktif, cepat tanggap, dan mampu bekerja dengan target serta deadline. Deskripsi Pekerjaan Melakukan proses recruitment mulai dari membuat materi dan mempublikasikan lowongan, sourcing kandidat, screening CV, psikotes, interview, penilaian hingga rekomendasi kandidat. Melakukan pemenuhan kebutuhan manpower dan MPP sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan. Melakukan onboarding karyawan baru. Mengelola dan memperbarui data karyawan. Membuat laporan recruitment harian, mingguan, dan bulanan. Melakukan koordinasi dengan User terkait kebutuhan manpower dan proses seleksi kandidat. Mengelola database kandidat serta melakukan follow-up setiap tahapan proses recruitment.

jobs.title: Human Resources Intern
jobs.description: The Organization & Employee Development Intern will support the HR team in employee engagement activities, training and development, and organization development. The role involves assisting with planning, coordination, documentation, and program support while gaining practical experience in HR operations and communication. Core Responsibilities: Documentation & Logistics Support: Assist in preparing HR program materials, coordinating event logistics, maintaining accurate records, organizing files, and communicating schedules and requirements to participants. Program Implementation Support: Support the execution of employee engagement and development activities by facilitating sessions, assisting speakers, monitoring program delivery, collecting feedback, and ensuring smooth event operations. Event Proposal Development: Help conceptualize and prepare employee engagement event proposals, conduct research, collaborate with stakeholders, create multimedia materials for internal communications, and develop a comprehensive event proposal from planning through execution.
